glossary.title: Glossary

workflow.autoApproveDesc: When enabled, manually saved translations skip Draft status and go directly to Reviewed.
workflow.propagateDesc: When a string is saved, automatically propagate the translation to untranslated strings with identical source text.
workflow.hideIgnoredDesc: When enabled, strings marked as ignored are hidden in the editor by default.
workflow.endPunctMatchDesc: Flag a QA warning when the translation ends with different punctuation than the source (.  !  ?  …).
workflow.minWordCountDesc: Minimum number of words required in a translation (0 = disabled, 1 = default).
workflow.skipTes4Desc: Exclude TES4 header records during ESP/ESM file import.
workflow.ragEnabledDesc: Retrieve similar reviewed translations and pass them as few-shot examples to the LLM.
workflow.ragMaxExamplesDesc: How many similar translations to include per string (1–10).
workflow.ragMinSimilarityDesc: Minimum cosine similarity for embedding-based retrieval (0–1). TM matches ignore this threshold.
